lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately vertical columns. A distinct vertical alignment of three high-intensity spots is visible in the mid-flank region posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running across the mid-lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and a shadowed trough on the ventral edge.
